items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I just told my boy, Kelvin Washington, who is now the band director at Howard University…

ctx.x: At this point, as you said earlier, you wanted to be a teacher? So?

I was going to Southern. I was taking history classes and I was minoring in music. I learned something about like, you know, like…. I mean black schools have a lot of weird issues. Cause I had taken all of these classes at the New Orleans Center for Creative Arts, and I was in a freshman harmony class and I wanted to test out of the class. And they wouldn’t let me test out of the class, because they didn’t want to make the other students feel inferior, or something like that. Because these kids were from small…
